C0_dependencies.name: MeasureTheory.BoundedCompactSupport.finset_sum
C0_dependencies.content:
/-- A finite sum of bounded compactly supported functions is bounded compactly supported. -/
theorem finset_sum
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, BoundedCompactSupport (F i)) :
    BoundedCompactSupport (fun x ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, F i x) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [BoundedCompactSupport.zero]
  | @insert j s hjs IH =>
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_insert hjs]
    apply BoundedCompactSupport.add
    · exact hF _ (Finset.mem_insert_self j s)
    · exact IH (fun i hi ↦ hF _ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

C1_dependencies.name: Finset.induction
C1_dependencies.content:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction {α : Type*} {p : Finset α → Prop} [DecidableEq α] (empty : p ∅)
    (insert : ∀ ⦃a : α⦄ {s : Finset α}, a ∉ s → p s → p (insert a s)) : ∀ s, p s :=
  cons_induction empty fun a s ha => (s.cons_eq_insert a ha).symm ▸ insert ha

    (insert : ∀ ⦃a : α⦄ {s : Finset α}, a ∉ s → p s → p (insert a s)) : ∀ s, p s :=
  cons_induction empty fun a s ha => (s.cons_eq_insert a ha).symm ▸ insert ha
